services.name: Pontoon Specs & Comfort
services.desc: Experience the adventure of a lifetime at Destin’s one-of-a-kind Crab Island! Hop aboard one of Tipsy Tiki’s Pontoon Boats and set sail to this iconic destination where wildlife, including dolphins and sea turtles, thrive! At Crab Island, there’s something for everyone, including shallow swimming areas, playgrounds for the kids, and refreshing beverages at the full service bar for adults. Check out the availability for our double decker Pontoon boat! Imagine soaring high above the water, spotting dolphins and sea turtles below, as you take in sweeping views of the city and the Gulf. Come take flight and discover Destin from up above! Once you purchase your tickets online, bring a photo ID to the Destin Harbor location (provided on the booking voucher). Please arrive at least 30 minutes prior to your scheduled departure time.
